raw.setBoundary: Include only turns that state (or directly imply) specific past concert/musical events attended, with any associated dates or “today/recently” context, so the downstream model can reconstruct a chronological list from earliest to latest within the past two months.
raw.missingRisk: Some sessions mention events as “recently” or without an explicit event date (e.g., Queen with Adam Lambert; Brooklyn festival). If the exact concert date is not stated, the downstream answerer may have to infer relative order using the session timestamps, which could mismatch actual event dates.
